title: Barramundi Pie
description: A classic British dish featuring roasted barramundi in a creamy cottage pie.
instructions: Season the barramundi fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the barramundi fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cottage cheese until melted and smooth.
Transfer the barramundi fillets to a baking dish.
Pour the cottage cheese mixture over the top of the fish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
